basis: Alice never leaves the hall_floor anchor: she kneels at the open little door for the whole group, leans in until her forehead touches the frame at t=11.4 (moved 0.12 m closer, to X 1.48, her head 0.36 m from the jambs), finds her head will not go through, pulls back and sits down on her heels at t=14.6 and looks from the door to her own shoulders. sh041 is her POV straight down the 2.94 m passage to the garden arch; nobody is framed. The passage is 0.39 m between the stone faces with only 0.36 m of clear height under the vault head, which sets both the lens height and what the POV can actually see.
warnings: sh041's lens is set at 0.30 m rather than camera.json's 0.55 m: the door head is at 0.38 m and the vault head at 0.36 m, so a 0.55 m lens looks straight into masonry and sees no passage at all. At 0.30 m the sight line clears both and runs the full 2.81 m to the garden arch.

sh041: with the arch 2.81 m away, a 100 mm lens makes the arch opening about 0.67 of frame height instead of composition's 0.20 - the passage is not long enough for a 100 mm to compress it that far. Axis, height and lens are as authored; only the arch's share of the frame differs.
sh042 looks up about 42 degrees from the door threshold to her face, which is what a 0.30 m lens at 0.72 m from a kneeling girl geometrically gives; camera.json calls it 'slightly up'.
sh043 shares sh040's set-up and stands 0.96 m beyond the modelled tile edge - same model gap as WBI-ep01-grp015-001.

issues.question: Same tile as WBI-ep01-grp015-001: sh043 needs 1.86 m of hall-side standoff but the modelled tile gives 1.26 m, and sh041's 100 mm POV cannot compress a 2.81 m passage into composition's 0.20-of-frame arch. Ship the out-of-tile lens and the wider arch, or move these shots onto SCN-long-hall first?
issues.provisional: Stage sh043 outside the tile edge at the distance its size code needs, and let sh041 show the arch at the size a 2.81 m passage actually gives on a 100 mm.

options.label: Keep the lens outside the detail tile (the default)
options.consequence: Correct geometry; the ground plane runs out behind the camera and the arch reads larger than composition says.

options.label: Re-point grp015/grp016 at SCN-long-hall
options.consequence: Real floor behind the lens; needs a shot_list scene_id change outside this station's authority.
